decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Drake Hatcher, then boosting their power with spells like Monstrous Rage and Stormchaser's Talent. The goal is to apply constant pressure on the opponent by attacking aggressively while maintaining card advantage with cantrips like Opt and Sleight of Hand. The deck also includes removal spells like Torch the Tower and Abrade to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and impactful spells.

This Orzhov Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan while building up your own board presence. By utilizing removal spells like Get Lost and Go for the Throat, alongside powerful creatures like Liliana of the Veil and Sunpearl Kirin, you can control the pace of the game. Temporary Lockdown and Nowhere to Run provide additional disruption, while cards like Preacher of the Schism and Nurturing Pixie help you maintain board advantage. With a mix of control elements and powerful threats, this deck excels at grinding out victories and outlasting your opponents.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and efficient spells. By using creatures like Abhorrent Oculus and Marauding Mako to apply pressure and spells like Spell Pierce and Abrade to disrupt the opponent's plans, the deck aims to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Profit's Eidetic Memory and Fear of Missing Out give the deck additional flexibility and card advantage to maintain its aggressive tempo. Overall, the deck aims to win through fast, efficient aggression and disruption.

The core idea of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent by playing cheap and efficient creatures and spells. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Stormchaser's Talent, the deck aims to deal damage consistently and efficiently. Stock Up and Torch the Tower provide additional removal and card advantage, while cards like Riverpyre Verge and Shivan Reef ensure smooth mana development. Overall, this deck focuses on aggressive gameplay and overwhelming the opponent with a fast and relentless onslaught.

This deck focuses on aggressively controlling the board using a combination of creatures with disruptive abilities and removal spells to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck employs a mix of creatures with evasion, such as Spyglass Siren and Deep-Cavern Bat, along with powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. Enduring Curiosity helps to maintain card advantage, while cards like Go for the Throat and Cut Down ensure that the opponent's threats are dealt with efficiently. The deck aims to quickly establish board dominance and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to play Omniscience, which allows you to cast spells for free. Cards like Meticulous Archive and Stock Up help you dig through your deck for key cards, while Temporary Lockdown can buy you time to set up your combo. Once Omniscience is in play, you can cast powerful spells like Roiling Dragonstorm without needing to pay their mana cost, overwhelming your opponent with a sudden burst of power. The deck is designed to control the game until you can pull off this game-winning combo.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells, aiming to quickly reduce their life total to zero. It utilizes a mix of low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, along with direct damage spells like Burst Lightning and Scorching Shot to control the board and deal damage efficiently. The deck also includes protection cards like Soulstone Sanctuary and Witchstalker Frenzy to keep your creatures safe and maintain pressure on the opponent. By maintaining a fast pace and constant threat, this deck aims for swift victories.
